ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 40:60 ratio of high-intensity white pixels to low-intensity black/dark grey pixels across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous white regions occupy the upper-central areas of both lobes. The left lobe contains distinct vertical dark striations or 'drip' marks extending from the leading edge into the white field. The right lobe presents a more uniform white field with sparse, small dark punctate spots. Both lobes are framed by thick, solid black pigmentation at the distal tips and along the trailing edges.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central depression with a calculated interior angle of approximately 52 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations across both trailing edges. The left lobe exhibits jagged, non-uniform peaks. The right lobe displays more rhythmic, saw-tooth serrations with increasing amplitude toward the distal tip.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Outer leading edges show a strong upward concavity. Trailing edges follow a sigmoidal curve tapering from the tips toward the median notch.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Localized cluster of circular, high-contrast white spots concentrated on the far distal tip and leading edge of the left lobe, consistent with barnacle colonization sites.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Three distinct, parallel dark linear marks (rake marks) cutting vertically through the white pigmentation on the medial section of the left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A notable irregular notch/indentation is visible on the far right trailing edge tip, distinct from standard serrations. Multiple small circular depigmented scars are scattered across the dark regions of both lobes.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique 'ink-drop' pigmentation pattern on the left lobe where dark pixels bleed into the white central field in vertical streaks.
